name: Call of Air
summary: Xanis Flameweaver sends seasoned Horde shamans from Thunder Bluff south to seek Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles. There they seek communion with the wind and the Air Totem, needed to channel its swift forces.

sections.title: The Whispering Winds
sections.body: A shaman who has attuned to earth, fire, and water now faces air, the final element. From Thunder Bluff, Xanis Flameweaver guides initiates through a trial of humility, focus, and respect for the sky. The winds are fickle and harder to control than the elements they have already learned.

sections.title: A Pilgrimage South
sections.body: The path leads south, past the Barrens and into the canyons of Thousand Needles. Far to the east, Prate Cloudseer dwells in a secluded cave on the cliffs, where canyon drafts howl day and night. She tests each initiate's preparedness before giving them the Air Totem, which channels gusts, lightning, and swift wind spirits.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Xanis Flameweaver, a shaman trainer in Thunder Bluff, sends you to attune to air after you have gained enough experience.
Prate Cloudseer lives in a sheltered cave far to the east in Thousand Needles, just south of the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is the element of air sought last?
faq.answer: Shamans seek air last because its currents are erratic and elusive. Tradition calls for mastering earth, fire, and water before attempting to attune to the wild winds.

faq.q: What do I receive upon finding Prate Cloudseer?
faq.answer: Prate Cloudseer gives you the Air Totem, a conduit for focusing your elemental magic and calling on air spirits for support.

faq.q: Is this quest exclusive to Tauren?
faq.answer: Any Horde shaman who has attuned to earth, fire, and water can travel from Thunder Bluff to Thousand Needles to claim an Air Totem.

faq.q: What happens after finishing this quest?
faq.answer: When you arrive, Prate Cloudseer gives you the Air Totem, letting you invoke wind-based totems immediately. She also offers further training and trials to hone your connection with the sky.

angles.text: As a shaman, completing your elemental set marks a turning point. The Air Totem opens the way to swift currents and lightning-wreathed powers.
As a Horde shaman, binding Kalimdor's wild winds in a sacred totem strengthens your faction's spiritual backbone.
As a Tauren, you revere the winds as sacred messengers. They carry the Earth Mother's whispers across the plains from Mulgore's towering bluffs.
